Authors record evidence once, reviewers start from checked findings, and builders share one contract

Paper authors

  • Record claims, results, and evidence while you work
  • Start with three: experiments, claim→evidence links, the paper
  • Every field is optional; gaps become coverage notes
  • Refuted hypotheses count as honest negative results

Reviewers and AECs

  • Start from deterministic findings, each with a way to re-derive it
  • See how each claim was checked, on one ladder
  • Use a draft where every point quotes the paper
  • You set scores, badges, and the recommendation

Tool builders, venues

  • Build to an open schema and spec; claim levels L1–L4
  • Plug in your own model, runner, and venue profile
  • Read sealed runs from CI and dashboards
  • Map venue badge checklists onto the profile
